sources: Google Maps place 'Sanilac County Forester Campground' (gm.py, 2026-10-22)

values.note: Nightly: 30-amp water & electric $40, 30-amp full hookup $45, 50-amp full hookup $50; tent sites $30 (rustic) and $35 (20-amp electric); rustic cabin $90. Weekly $240-300, monthly $720-900, seasonal $2,400-3,200 for the RV sites. One rate for everyone (no resident split posted). Paid in full when booked.

fees.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/forester-park-rates/ (Nightly/Weekly/Monthly/Seasonal table; page '© 2026 Sanilac County Parks', rates not otherwise dated), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/ ('51 Full-Hookup 30-Amp Sites', '73 Full-Hookup 50-Amp Sites', '47 Water & Electric 30-Amp Sites', '3 Water & Electric 50-Amp Sites'; amenities '30 amp hookups 50 amp hookups Sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 174 RV sites (51 full-hookup 30-amp, 73 full-hookup 50-amp, 47 water & electric 30-amp, 3 water & electric 50-amp), 7 tent sites with electric and 13 rustic tent sites, plus 5 cabins. Sites are assigned by the manager; no specific site guaranteed. Four adults per site.

sites.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/ (site counts) + https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/forester-park-rules/ ('No specific site can be guaranteed'; 'Maximum of four (4) adults per site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Dump & water fill $10. Park store sells firewood and park merchandise.

facilities.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/ ('Accessible restrooms Accessible showers'; 'Dump station $10 (Dump & Water Fill)'; 'Park Store'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Bonfire, the park's 'Book Now'), by phone or in person; paid in full when booked. The season's reservations open at 8 am on the first business day after New Year's. No refunds on holiday or special-event weekends. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm; registration at the office on arrival.

booking.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/forester-park-rules/ ('Reservations ... can be made by phone, in person or online'; 'Reservations for the season begin at 8 am on the first business day after New Years') + https://sanilaccountyparks.com/forester-park/ ('Book Now' -> https://book.letsbonfire.com/foresterpark), read 2026-10-22

note: Sanilac County park on Lake Huron, 6 mi N of Port Sanilac on M-25 (2820 N Lakeshore Rd, Carsonville), with a swimming beach, dog beach, pavilions, playground and nature trails. Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal sites. --Claude
